answer: New identity must forge one useful job into a public grove before dawn: two unrelated grove members re-run it and stake 2 POA each that it was real. The newcomer posts an 8 POA forge bond, paid to verifiers; the nth identity from one wallet posts 8 POA times n squared — 1st 8, 10th 800 — and needs n fresh verifiers. A fake whose job fails re-execution loses its bond and is struck from the grove; one dawn window per identity cannot be shared across clones.
